newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia Megionneftegaz won't issue ADR in 1st qtr.
newsitem.headline: Russia Megionneftegaz won't issue ADR in 1st qtr.

text.p: Russia's NK Megionneftegaz oil producer will issue level one American Depositary Receipts (ADR), but not in the first quarter of this year, a spokesman for Slavneft holding company which controls Megion, said on Monday.
Asked if the issue would be in the first quarter, Nikolai Starostin told Reuters: "No. It is a rather long-term question." Dealers had expected the issue in the first quarter.
Starostin did not comment further on the OAO Slavneft Megionneftegaz ADR issue.
Megion's financial advisor said in January that the ADR, which would allow trading of domestic shares on foreign exchanges, would be issued in the first quarter.
Slavneft is a joint Russian-Belarussian oil company.
Megion plans to produce 11.95 million tonnes of oil in 1997, down from 12.47 million tonnes of oil in 1996 and 12.84 million tonnes in 1995.
